display.purpose: The single H1, inside the message centre.

headline.purpose: Section H2s; the closing H2 scales up to clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5.5rem).

title.purpose: H3s, spec-sheet terms, job and lead-cause titles.

readout.purpose: Numerals and values on a readout: severity, cost range, distance band, trip values.

lede.purpose: Paragraph under a headline, muted, 52ch max.

body.purpose: Prose in silver or muted, 52 to 70ch, tabular numerals on.

label.purpose: Uppercase legends printed on instruments: lamp names, dial CTAs, readout terms, stage names. Never section kickers.

shadows.name: start-button
shadows.purpose: Recessed ring inside the start button's sky gradient border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing for every transition.

motion.name: button
motion.purpose: Button colour, border and press transitions; start button scale.

motion.name: lamp
motion.purpose: Lamp bulb lighting and label colour; swipe card return.

motion.name: needle
motion.purpose: Dial needle sweep to the active step.

motion.name: bulb-check
motion.purpose: Ignition: all lamps amber, needles at the stop, then the loop starts. Skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: auto-advance
motion.purpose: Lamp loop interval; pauses on hover, focus, off-screen and user control; never starts under reduced motion.

components.css: .ds-lamps { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-lamp { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.35rem; background: none; border: 0; color: var(--dim, #7a8590); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; } .ds-lamp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sky, #38bdf8); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-bulb { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--unlit, #2a333b); color: var(--unlit, #2a333b); background: var(--bezel, #0d1216); transition: background-color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-lamp-label { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-lamp:hover .ds-bulb { border-color: var(--dim, #7a8590); color: var(--dim, #7a8590); } .ds-lamp[data-state='done'] .ds-bulb { border-color: var(--sky-deep, #0ea5e9); color: var(--sky, #38bdf8); } .ds-lamp[data-state='done'] .ds-lamp-label { color: var(--muted, #9aa3ad); } .ds-lamp[data-state='on'] .ds-bulb { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, var(--sky-soft, #7dd3fc), var(--sky, #38bdf8) 60%, var(--sky-deep, #0ea5e9)); border-color: var(--sky-soft, #7dd3fc); color: var(--sky-ink, #04131c); } .ds-lamp[data-state='on'] .ds-lamp-label { color: var(--sky, #38bdf8); } .ds-lamp[data-state='on'][data-kind='warn'] .ds-bulb { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, #ffd27a, var(--amber, #f5a524) 60%, #d98a0b); border-color: #ffd27a; color: var(--amber-ink, #1d1203); } .ds-lamp[data-state='on'][data-kind='warn'] .ds-lamp-label { color: var(--amber, #f5a524); }

narrative.overview:
Every RevX surface is a dashboard seen from the driver's seat at night: smoked black glass, thin bezel rules, dial arcs with tick scales, and LCD message-centre screens, lit by one sky-blue backlight. Content is presented as readouts, not marketing blocks. A step in a process is a tell-tale lamp; a ranked list is a set of readings where the lead is lit and the alternates sit dashed and dim; something not built yet is a lamp with no wire behind it.

The system runs on a four-state vocabulary that every component speaks: **unlit** (bezel fill, dark glyph), **lit** (sky gradient bulb or solid sky rule), **warning** (amber), and **dimmed-not-wired** (dashed outline, dim glyph). Solid means chosen, confirmed, or live. Dashed means alternate, sealed, pending, placeholder, or not built. Density is that of a cluster: compact readouts inside generous dark margins, with condensed uppercase legends doing the labelling.

Photography is allowed only as a dim backdrop behind the glass (the hero garage at 0.42 opacity, masked to transparent) or as a framed image inside an instrument screen. Depth comes from soft, long, black drop shadows under glass panels, never from glow.
keyCharacteristics: Smoked black ground with a cool blue-grey neutral ramp; one sky backlight carries every lit state and the primary action.
Barlow Condensed for everything that is printed on the dash (headings, legends, numerals, buttons); Barlow for prose; tabular numerals everywhere.
Four light states (unlit, lit, warning, not-wired) and a solid/dashed distinction reused across lamps, lists, quotes, seals, avatars and roadmap.
Circles for anything that lights up (lamps, dials, start button, swipe buttons); rounded rectangles for glass and screens; pills for buttons and chips.
Motion is mechanical: needles sweep, bulbs light, panels fade in from a slight blur, all on one long ease-out.

rules.name: The One Backlight Rule
rules.body: Sky is the only colour that means "lit". If something is on, chosen, or the primary action, it is sky; nothing else competes for that job.

rules.name: The Signal Reserve Rule
rules.body: Amber means caution or unresolved; red means stop. Neither is ever decoration, a brand accent, or a hover colour.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Light Rule
rules.body: Text on a lit surface uses that light's ink (sky-ink, amber-ink), not white.

rules.name: The Printed Legend Rule
rules.body: Uppercase condensed caps label a reading inside an instrument (a lamp, a dial, a readout term, a screen header). They never float above a section headline as a kicker.

rules.name: The Billing Rule
rules.body: Ranked readings are billed by rank: the lead reading is set larger, in ink, and lit; alternates are smaller and muted; where the order among alternates is known, size steps down again (1.375rem, 1rem, 0.9375rem in the hero cause list).

rules.name: The No-Bloom Rule
rules.body: Light lives inside a shape (gradient fill, coloured border, coloured glyph). Shadows are black and fall downward; they are never coloured.

dos: Do express every status through the four light states: unlit, lit (sky), warning (amber), not-wired (dashed, dim).
Do draw the chosen or confirmed item solid and lit, and its alternates dashed and dim.
Do bill ranked items by rank: the lead larger and in ink, alternates smaller and muted.
Do put lit text in that light's ink (sky-ink #04131c on sky, amber-ink #1d1203 on amber).
Do use Barlow Condensed caps for anything printed on an instrument and keep tabular numerals on for every readout and price.
Do nest radii inward (1.75rem bezel, 0.9rem screen, 0.4rem row) and make anything that lights a circle.
Do keep motion on the one ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) and hold every auto-advance under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use amber or red for anything but caution and stop.
Don't add coloured glows or outer blooms; light fills shapes and shadows stay black.
Don't use a dashed stroke as decoration; dashed always means alternate, sealed, placeholder or not built.
Don't place uppercase legends above section headlines as kickers; legends label instrument readings only.
Don't show photography at full strength behind content; it is a dim masked backdrop or an image framed inside a screen.
Don't put white text on a lit sky or amber surface.
